=== owners.POST.yml ===
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkHousehold

# Household-duplicate block: the household is keyed on the computed householdId (lastName +
# postcode), so joining an existing household is a 409 by default. 'sharesHousehold' bypasses this
# block, creating the owner as a declared household member.
checkHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerHouseholdUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkIdentityUnique

# Single, consolidated duplicate check: the whole identityKey
# (normalizedTelephone|email|householdId). Runs after the household id is finalized so the key is
# complete, and before the capacity/limit checks so a duplicate is still rejected first. Unlike the
# household block above, this is NOT bypassed by 'sharesHousehold'.
checkIdentityUnique:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerIdentityUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkCityCapacity

checkCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkDailyLimit

checkDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdSize

assignHouseholdSize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdSize
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

# Soft-match flag: not a hard duplicate (already rejected above), but shares an existing owner's
# lastName and postcode with a different telephone. Runs after the owner's fields are finalized and
# before save, so it compares against every already-persisted owner.
assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

Implemented the disposable-domain blocklist by extending the shared email choke point rather than adding a new pipeline step.

So the blocklist is enforced consistently on both create and update with no new wiring, exception, or handler needed. The domain check runs against the already-lower-cased value, making the match case-insensitive.

The new `Cp38Tests.errorRejectsDisposableDomain` (posting `x@mailinator.com`) passes, and all 52 tests remain green.
